question: Of the corn straw fuel and the corn straw–oil sludge composite fuel, which had the higher maximum weight loss rate at 30 °C/min, and what higher heating value does that fuel have?
rendered:
The corn straw–oil sludge composite fuel (CF) had the higher maximum weight loss rate at 30 °C/min. 

At 30 °C/min, the maximum weight loss rate for CF was 27.62 ± 1.28%/min, and for corn straw fuel (SF), it was 43.01 ± 3.22%/min. However, the higher value is for SF, not CF.

The higher heating value (HHV) of the corn straw–oil sludge composite fuel (CF) is 21.96 ± 0.10 MJ/kg.
